capabilities: Map vault folders to GitHub, Forgejo, or Gitea repositories with push-only, pull-only, or bidirectional sync
Resolve conflicts via mtime auto-resolve, 3-way text merge, and a keep-local/keep-remote/keep-both modal
Rewrite Obsidian Markdown (wikilinks, callouts, highlights, math, Excalidraw embeds) to GitHub-renderable form at push
Encrypt destination contents end-to-end with AES-256-GCM before upload
Back up local files before any pull-modify or pull-delete and prune stale local-only files
disambiguation: Not a general Git client for the vault; it syncs chosen folders to repos without exposing Git commands, SSH keys, or history tools.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; deeper technical walkthroughs live in docs/how-it-works.md.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Sync covers your whole vault. Easy Git is for the case where you want to share only one or two folders
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync covers the whole vault, and typical Git workflows need CLI and SSH setup; there is no simple way to sync single folders to repos.

relations.evidence: turn on Auto-export SVG (or PNG) in the Excalidraw plugin's settings

requires.name: Personal access token (or Device Flow sign-in)

summary: Folder-level Git sync plugin that maps individual vault folders to GitHub or Forgejo/Gitea repos with bidirectional sync, conflicts, and backups.
